import gzip,hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from evaluation.manifests import now
out=Path("evaluation/evidence/f/v2-checkpoint-history-20261107")
run=Path("evaluation/runs/v2-checkpoint-history-20261107")
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
receipts={}
for path in sorted(out.glob("*-command.json")):
 label=path.name.removesuffix("-command.json")
 r=json.loads(path.read_text());raw=gzip.decompress((out/(label+".log.gz")).read_bytes())
 assert sha(raw)==r["outputSha256"] and not r["timedOut"],label
 assert r["exitCode"]==(1 if label in ("red","red-corrected","green") else 0),label
 state=json.loads((run/(label+".log.process.json")).read_text())
 assert state["status"]=="STOPPED" and state["pid"]==r["pid"],label
 receipts[label]=dict(receiptSha256=sha(path.read_bytes()),outputSha256=sha(raw),exitCode=r["exitCode"])
before=json.loads((out/"inputs-before.json").read_text());after=json.loads((out/"inputs-after.json").read_text())
assert (len(before["sourcePins"]),len(before["localInputs"]),len(before["helpers"]))==(899,252,4)
assert after["unchangedOwnerPaths"]==899 and after["unchangedLocalInputs"]==252 and after["unchangedHelpers"]==4
initial=json.loads((out/"inputs-initial.json").read_text())
assert sha((out/"mutants-initial.py.txt").read_bytes())==initial["helpers"]["mutants.py"]
for p,d in before["localInputs"].items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==d,p
for p,d in before["helpers"].items():assert sha((out/p).read_bytes())==d,p
peers=json.loads((out/"communication-final.json").read_text())
assert not peers["missingBranches"] and len(peers["files"])==390
assert not any(v["ambiguous"] or v["divergentRevisions"] for v in peers["files"].values())
assert peers["branches"]==json.loads((out/"communication-before.json").read_text())["branches"]
results={}
for label,count in (("green-corrected",34),("focused",384),("root",2583)):
 raw=gzip.decompress((out/(label+".log.gz")).read_bytes()).decode()
 match=re.search(r"(\d+) passed in ([\d.]+)s",raw)
 assert match and int(match[1])==count,label
 results[label]=dict(passed=count,pytestSeconds=float(match[2]))
mutants=json.loads(gzip.decompress((out/"mutants.log.gz").read_bytes()))
assert len(mutants)==8 and all(v["validControlPassed"] and v["deliberateBypassDetected"] for v in mutants)
result=dict(recordedAt=now(),commandsVerified=len(receipts),receipts=receipts,results=results,
 deliberateBypassesDetected=8,inputsSha256=sha((out/"inputs-before.json").read_bytes()),
 coreSha256=sha(Path("evaluation/checkpoint_history_v2.py").read_bytes()),unchangedOwnerPaths=899,
 unchangedLocalInputs=252,unchangedHelpers=4,communicationPaths=390,consumerMappingAck=None,
 completeRuntimeReady=False,executionAuthorized=False,fCases="NOT_RUN",fGate="NOT_RUN",gGate="LOCKED")
assert not (out/"verification.json").exists()
(out/"verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
